gizmo.title: Nyocha ihe agụrụ
gizmo.description: Ndị na-amụ ihe na-etinye ọkọlọtọ n'ahịrịokwu, paragraf ma ọ bụ onyonyo n'ihe a na-agụ nke bụ ihe akaebe maka akara ọ bụla, ma ọ bụ họrọ akụkụ nke kacha zaa ajụjụ.

configure.title: Ajụjụ
configure.description: Ihe a gwara ndị na-amụ ihe ka ha chọta n'ihe a na-agụ.

configure.title: Ọrụ
configure.description: Kaa ihe akaebe: ndị na-amụ ihe na-amado ọkọlọtọ ọ bụla n'akụkụ ihe akaebe ya. Họrọ otu: ndị na-amụ ihe na-ahọrọ naanị otu akụkụ kacha zaa ajụjụ.

configure.title: Ndị na-amụ ihe na-ahọrọ
configure.description: Ihe onye na-amụ ihe na-atụ aka na ya n'ihe a na-agụ. Enwere ike ịhọrọ onyonyo mgbe niile.

configure.title: Ọkọlọtọ
configure.description: Akara ndị na-amụ ihe na-etinye. Jiri Kaa azịza na menu ngọngọ ka ịhọrọ ebe nke ọ bụla kwesịrị.

configure.title: Ihe a na-agụ
configure.description: Ihe a na-agụ nke ndị na-amụ ihe na-arụ ọrụ na ya. HTML ọ bụla: isiokwu, paragraf, ndepụta na onyonyo.

configure.title: Usoro akara
configure.description: OER Schema: usoro akara maka nyocha a (dịka akara, mkpụrụedemede, pasentị, mmecha).

configure.title: Ebumnuche mmụta
configure.description: OER Schema: ebumnuche mmụta jikọtara na nyocha a.

configure.title: Kọọsị
configure.description: OER Schema: kọọsị e mere nyocha a maka ya.

advanced.title: Mgbalị
advanced.description: Ugboro ole onye na-amụ ihe nwere ike ịlele. 0 pụtara na-enweghị njedebe.

advanced.title: Nwere ike ịdaba
advanced.description: Gosi ajụjụ a dị ka ahịrị na-emeghe ma na-emechi. Imeghe otu na-emechi ajụjụ ndị ọzọ nwere ike ịdaba dị n'akụkụ ya.

advanced.title: Malite ka ọ daba
advanced.description: Mgbe ọ nwere ike ịdaba, ọ na-amalite dị ka ahịrị emechiri nke na-egosi naanị ajụjụ na ọnọdụ ya.

developer.title: Aha ule
developer.description: Aha ule e zigara maka iji na gburugburu xAPI iji mata ihe a
